notes.min_recall_at_k: At least 70% of expected sources must appear in top-k results
notes.min_mrr: First acceptable source must appear within top 2 on average
notes.min_ndcg: Ranking quality must exceed 0.5 normalized DCG
notes.min_topic_coverage: At least 75% of topic groups must be covered
notes.max_forbidden_hits: No forbidden sources may appear in results
notes.min_empty_pass_rate: All off-domain queries must return empty results
notes.min_approximate_recall: HNSW must find at least 85% of exact search results
